meta.roadmapNote: The roadmap and every missable flag are built from the official descriptions alone: a trophy tied to one named mission, one choice or one second attempt is flagged missable, because the description gives no second chance.
meta.sourcesNote: Official names, descriptions and grades follow the PlayStation 5 list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles (both agree on every entry). Every guide below is Platinum Road's own writing, built from those official descriptions; no walkthrough text is copied.
meta.title: Platinum Road - Leonida Trophy Atlas

trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap in this atlas, not a task of its own. Work the stages in order, keep the missable nine flagged in Stage 1 and Stage 5 under watch, and this pops on your final cleanup trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (grade). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission named in the official description. It is unmissable story progress: play the prologue through to its end and the trophy lands as the chapter opens up. No collectible or side task is tied to it, so simply do not skip the intro sequence.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete every mission of Chapter 1 and this chapter trophy unlocks automatically. Because the description ties it to the chapter as a whole rather than one mission, there is nothing optional to hunt here: follow the story markers in order and finish the chapter finale.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be missed while you play the story in order; clear each Chapter 2 mission and it unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (name as published, description, grade); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep playing the main story and finish the chapter's closing mission; the trophy is awarded for the chapter, so partial progress through individual missions is not enough on its own. Nothing in the official description suggests a side requirement.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last of the four numbered chapter trophies. Finish its missions in story order and the trophy unlocks as the endgame opens. After this chapter, check the missable list in this atlas before pushing into the final missions.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story for this gold trophy. Before you start it, sweep up the mission-tied missables flagged in this atlas (the named-mission trophies and the choices trophy), because the description points at one specific mission: once the credits roll, chapter replay is the only way back if the game offers it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: gold); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Flagged missable in this atlas because the official description ties the trophy to one named mission rather than a chapter: if you rush past its story window, use chapter or mission replay to return. Do it the first time the mission is offered and it costs nothing extra.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one mission.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Flagged missable because it hangs on a single named story mission: finish the heist when the story offers it, including its escape, and the trophy unlocks at mission end. If the mission window passes, mission replay is the fallback named in this atlas's roadmap notes.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a single named mission, so this atlas flags it missable: play it through when it appears in the story instead of leaving it behind a point of no return, and the trophy pops as the mission closes.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Flagged missable for the same reason as the other named-mission trophies: the official description names one mission only. Finish Headliners during its story chapter; if you advance beyond it, return through mission replay.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one mission.

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport-authority mission named in the description. Flagged missable because it is one named mission: clear it when the story sends you to VCIA. Note the separate VCIA trophy, Catch Me If You Can, which is also tied to that location and is flagged in Stage 5.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one mission.

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A single named operation in the official description, so this atlas flags it missable: finish the operation when it is offered in the story and the trophy unlocks at its end; mission replay is the recovery route if the window closes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one mission.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion for this gold trophy. It is the umbrella over almost everything else in the list: story, stranger strands, collectibles and activity counters all feed the percentage the game tracks. Use the counter in this tracker, work the roadmap stages in order, and let the checklist here mirror your in-game completion screen before the final push.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: gold); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (PSN tracks completion). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts for this silver trophy; PlayStation tracks the count, and so does the counter in this tracker. Stunts are a free-roam grind rather than a story task: work them in batches while exploring Leonida for The Goodtime State, and log each session's total here so the long count never gets lost.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: silver); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 250). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: the starter list counts 9 activity types. This is the sampler trophy: start one activity of every kind on the map (races, fishing, shooting range and the rest), and a single attempt at each is enough, because the description asks you to try them, not to win them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges for this silver trophy; the 42 is the count PlayStation tracks. Gold means the top medal on every single challenge, not a single visit: practise each weapon class, replay any challenge that lands silver, and tick the counter here challenge by challenge.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: silver); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 42). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location: 14 locations in total. A win is required at each one, not just a finish, so retry a course until you take first place, then move on. Log each location in the counter here as you clear it so none is visited twice by mistake.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 14 locations). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different does the work in the official description: repeating one easy race twenty times does not count. Spread your wins across 20 separate race events and track them with the counter in this atlas.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 20). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing contact named in the description: take his challenge when it is offered, out-fish him, and the trophy unlocks. If you lose, the challenge can be attempted again, so this one is about winning once, not about a story window.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. The description asks for a completion, not a high score: pick the shortest arcade cabinet you find, play it to its end, and the trophy is yours. It pairs naturally with Master of None, since an arcade game is one of the activity types.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, which means working Andy's whole strand of missions through to its last job, not just meeting him once. Stranger strands like this one also feed Strangers & Freaks, so finish the strand rather than sampling it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton by finishing Kenton's strand end to end. Each named contact in this part of the list has a closing mission; the trophy is for the finale, so keep returning to Kenton until no more of his markers appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work Billy's strand from its first job to its last; the trophy unlocks only on the final mission, so a strand left half done earns nothing here, though it still counts toward the eight strands of Strangers & Freaks once finished.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida for this silver trophy. A strand means a contact's whole chain, first mission to final mission: the named finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone in this list are five of them. Track finished strands with the counter here.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: silver); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 8). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy by playing Randy's strand through to its end. As with the other named contacts, only the closing mission triggers the trophy, so keep the strand moving whenever Randy's marker is on the map.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand in full; together with Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, this is one of the five named stranger finales the official list calls out, and each one also advances Strangers & Freaks toward its eight strands.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots. This is a collectible sweep in activity clothing: visit each meditation spot once and use the interaction there. Log them in the counter here region by region, and pair the hunt with The Goodtime State's exploration.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 18). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret is the hunting contact in the description: take his hunt, track the one unique animal it names, and bring the hunt to its conclusion. It is a single special hunt, not a quota of ordinary animals.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets for this silver trophy. Sets, not loose cards: a set only counts when every card in it is found, so focus your hunting on finishing sets one at a time instead of scattering pickups. Track completed sets with the counter here.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: silver); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 3 sets). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations for this silver trophy; PlayStation tracks the count to 100. Treat it as a state-wide sweep: work district by district while exploring, and log progress in the counter here so the last twenty locations are easy to plan.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: silver); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 100). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's short-form tasks; fifty completions is a steady grind rather than a test of one skill. Mix them into free-roam sessions between story missions and keep the counter here honest after each batch.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 50). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while you are with your partner, and escape the heat to finish it. The two conditions in the description both matter: raise the wanted level to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay clean until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level in between. The chain is the hard part: plan three nearby shops, keep the wanted level alive between them (do not hide until it drops), and finish the third robbery with the heat still on you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery is about variety: get into vehicles you have not used before whenever you see one parked or passing, across rich and poor districts alike, since each area spawns different traffic. The counter here tracks how close the hundred is.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 100). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Set the moment up before you trigger it: gather a group of five or more enemies, position yourself with a loaded weapon, then activate Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. A failed attempt costs nothing, so retry on any busy fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport from Hi-Jacked. Flagged missable because the description ties the act to that one location and its story context: while you are at VCIA around the VCIA Takedown mission, leave in a way no schedule allows (an aircraft that was never cleared to go). If the story moves you on, return to VCIA in free roam and try the departure there.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description naming one location.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke with a vehicle in it: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and it is hot inside one. Get into a Rhino tank and spend time in it (a high wanted level brings them to you) and the trophy should follow; the official words give no count, so this atlas claims nothing more precise than that.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description, which names the Rhino.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Detection is the fail state, not the police arriving afterwards: plan the entry, keep staff and cameras from raising the alarm during the robbery itself, and leave quietly. If you are spotted mid-robbery, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one, for this silver trophy. A vault only counts when you get away, so the escape route matters as much as the robbery: scout the area, park a fast vehicle close, and log each successful vault in the counter here.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (grade: silver); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 5). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Stop or breach the truck, take what it carries, and then actually get away: the description makes the escape part of the trophy, so do not stop to fight once you have the money. One clean truck is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: the exploration count behind this trophy is 52 areas. Sweep the map systematically, county by county, and uncover every named area at least once. Pair it with the meditation spots and WAiNK locations, which take you to the same far corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 52 areas). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang: 9 gangs, one operation each. Variety is the requirement, so robbing the same gang twice does not advance it. Keep a list here of which gangs you have hit; the counter in this tracker is built for exactly that.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 9 gangs). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, the location named in the description, find the spot that serves drinks with a view, and use it. It is a quiet moment trophy: no skill, no count, just being in the right place and taking the drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (name with ellipsis, as published); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description naming Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass rather than the door. The description asks for the exit, not a purchase, so any showroom car and a straight line at the window will do.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, the venue named in the description: go there and bowl, completing the follow-through of a throw. One visit and one proper throw is the whole task as the official words describe it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list (name with curly apostrophe, as published); PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description naming the alley.

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague: a partnership with mass appeal. Read plainly, it points at the two leads' partnership and its public reach, most likely a shared activity done together that draws attention. This atlas claims no exact trigger the description does not name: progress the partner activities (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and story partnership beats, and note here when it lands.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, honest reading of the official description only.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 behind this trophy. Flagged missable in this atlas because choices, once made in a story, cannot be unmade on that save: think before the big story decisions, and keep a second save before major branches. The count suggests many small choices add up, so play decisively and often rather than reloading every outcome.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (PSN count: 500). Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description (choices cannot be unmade).

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. Flagged missable because the description needs a genuine first failure followed by a success: if you clear everything first try, deliberately take a repeatable challenge, fail it once, then pass it on the immediate retry. Do this early, while repeatable challenges are everywhere.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Missable call: Platinum Road, from the official description (a second attempt implies a first failure).

trophies.guide: Witness something strange: the description is the series' classic wink at a weird encounter out in the wilds of the map. Explore remote parts of Leonida, especially at night and away from the cities, and when something unexplainable happens, stay and watch it play out. This atlas invents no location the official words do not give.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, honest reading of the official description only.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian with a melee attack out of the vehicle so they go down like a bowling pin (the name is the joke). Line up a slow pass beside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and one clean knockdown is the task as described.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies. Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. This is a money grind with a specific currency: only marked bills passed through contacts count, not ordinary income. Run the laundering route whenever marked bills are in hand and log the running total in the counter here, in dollars.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: $250,000). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in the game. Ordinary play gets much of this: clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all add up, as long as the money passes through shops. The counter here tracks shop spending only, so you can see whether a final shopping spree is needed before the platinum push.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: $100,000). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 in total. Save income toward the garages as you play rather than at the end, because they also give your vehicle collecting somewhere to live. Buy each garage as it becomes affordable and tick it off in the counter here.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 8). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you take a vehicle you like, register it in the app before you abandon it; ten registrations is a small count that is easy to finish early if you make it a habit from your first hours in Leonida.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Exophase, GTA VI PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles, GTA VI trophies (count: 10). Advice: Platinum Road, from the official description naming the Scooter Bros app.
